LESSON: DRAWING PICTURES.

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Drawing pictures.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Drawing pictures., part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which things are found in our school environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Drawing pictures. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Unity: The learner shares drawing and colouring tools with others in the class.

• Peace: The learner practises patience in sharing the available drawing and colouring tools.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: Which things are found in our school environment?

Core competencies:

• Creativity and imagination: The learner creatively draws and colours things found within the school environment.

• Self-efficacy: The learner without assistance draws and colours pictures of things found within school and displays the

pictures for others to see.

Values:

• Unity: The learner shares drawing and colouring tools with others in the class.

• Peace: The learner practises patience in sharing the available drawing and colouring tools.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issue(
s) :

Personal hygiene awareness: The learner washes hands with clean water and soap after modelling things found within the

school environment.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Environmental Activities as the learner names things found in the school environment.

Creative Activities as the learner draws, colours and models different things found within the school.

Suggested Learning Resources: Chart, flashcards and book of letters of the syllables, writing board chart, books or a writing

board, modeling clay, plasticine, and crayon.
